thread:
emma-chen: Quick heads-up — launching Private Edge: a self-attestation + audit-pack workflow for private/VPC/on-prem installs. Customers can now submit compliance attestations from the Console, get an automated audit bundle, and optionally request an on-site packaging review. :tada:

raj-patel: This is the feature we've been waiting for for regulated customers. What exactly is in the audit bundle?

emma-chen: Good q — bundle includes: system manifest, package checksums, KMS/HSM integration proof (if used), service config snapshot, and attestation metadata. Customers can download a signed .zip or request an encrypted transfer to their S3/KV store.

oliver-smith: Timeline? When do SEs tell customers it's available?

emma-chen: Soft launch today to pilot customers (select accounts). Wide opt-in starts next Tue (1792411200). Pilot customers get priority help from SE + a one-hour runbook walkthrough.

security-bot: NOTE: the self-attest flow requires customers to confirm they control the listed network ranges and provide an admin-signed PDF. Automated checks will validate PKI chains where present.

support-ops: Support playbook has been uploaded to Confluence, quick link: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/self-attest (internal). SE playbook includes verification checklist and sample email templates for compliance officers.

raj-patel: Any CLI changes? Need a small change in our install script for air-gapped installs.

emma-chen: Yes — small opt-in flag for packaging mode. Example command for customers who want an offline audit package:

```
rwctl package-audit --mode offline --out /tmp/redwood-audit.zip --license <LICENSE_KEY>
```

deploy-bot: Deploy note: private-edge self-attest feature flag toggled in prod at 1792345800; rollout to regions eu-west-1, us-west-2 first.

oliver-smith: Security question from a pilot — does this alter KMS key usage or rotate keys?

emma-chen: No automatic rotation. If KMS/HSM proofs are provided we include usage metadata; customers must opt into key rotation recommendations in the Console. We're shipping a small KMS integration label in the audit bundle v1.

aisha-khan: Great work — team. Please make sure marketing and sales have a short one-pager they can share with compliance teams. SEs, coordinate with solutions-marketing for that asset.

raj-patel: Will update the pilot tracker and ping SEs. Also adding a checklist item for license enforcement verification.

support-ops: FYI — opening a dedicated Slack thread in #customer-success for pilot coordination. Link will be posted shortly.

emma-chen: Thanks everyone. If you find any gaps in the playbook, ping me or @security-bot. :thumbsup:
